rules.title: stdout carries data, never narration
rules.text: PROTOCOL invariant 6: stdout is the answer, the framed `--each` answers, the `--jsonl` events, or `--list-tools`/`--help` output, and nothing else. Breadcrumbs and diagnostics go to stderr, because the consumer pipes stdout into `jq`.

judgement.question: Does this write to stdout something that is not data — a breadcrumb, a progress line, or a diagnostic that a consumer piping stdout into `jq` would receive as part of the answer?

criteria.true: it is a diagnostic, breadcrumb, warning or narration on stdout
criteria.false: it is the answer, a framed item header or answer, a `--jsonl` event, or `--list-tools`/`--help` output
